'''Blue's Scizor''' (Japanese: '''グリーンのハッサム''' ''Green's Hassam'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{adv|Blue}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. As of ''[[PS276|My, My, My Mimic]]'', he is at [[level]] 82, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he "takes plenty of siestas."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}===
[[File:Blue Pokemon Red Ownership.png|thumb|250px|left|Scyther after spending time with Red]]
Prior to the start of the series, Blue gave his Scizor, as a Scyther, to [[Chuck]] for intensive training. One of the skills that he learned was reading his opponent's moves.

Scizor first appeared as a Scyther in ''[[PS018|A Tale of Ninetales]]'', when Scyther is accidentally [[trade]]d to {{adv|Red}} alongside Blue's other Pokémon. During the three days that Red has them, he attempts to get them to relax and open up to him, with little success. They later traded back, while keeping the caring attitude that Red instilled in them.

In ''[[PS029|Go for the Golbat]]'', Scyther battled [[Koga]]. Scyther attempted to strike Koga with {{m|Slash}}, but Koga's ninja armor, revealed to be a {{p|Grimer}}, quickly envelops the both of them, preventing any further action from Scyther. Blue attempted to use him again as a last ditch effort to defeat Koga but he was quickly countered by his {{p|Ekans}} and defeated.

As revealed in ''[[PS161|Entranced by Entei]]'', Scyther was used by Blue at some point during the [[Indigo Plateau|Pokémon League]].

==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}===
In a flashback shown in ''[[PS052|Growing Out of Gengar]]'', Blue used Scyther as his last attempt to defeat [[Agatha]]. Even though Agatha said that Scyther's physical attack will be no use against formless Pokémon, Blue is reminded of what his master once told him; that even though there's no form, you can still slice through an enemy without form so long as you grasp the essence of the foe. Blue then calls for a Slash from Scyther, slicing {{TP|Agatha|Gengar}} and {{p|Gastly}} to pieces.

In ''[[PS077|Striking Golduck]]'', Scyther is used alongside the rest of Blue's team to attack Agatha's Gengar. Despite a group attack Gengar escapes into Blue's shadow and attacks Scyther. Not wanting to give Gengar more places to hide Blue calls all his Pokémon back.

==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===
[[File:Blue and Scizor.png|thumb|200px|Scizor and Blue]]
In ''[[PS115|Forretress of Solitude]]'', it was revealed that Scyther had [[Evolution|evolved]] into a Scizor. In the [[PS116|next chapter]], Scizor fought against a group of wild Pokémon that started rampaging due to the [[Pokémon Music Channel|Pokémon March]] playing on a nearby radio. Scizor starts by attacking with {{m|Metal Claw}} and follows up by scaring the Pokémon with his two claws, which resemble heads. Scizor finishes the battle with {{m|False Swipe}}, allowing Blue to capture them all.

==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===
In ''[[PS271|...Now You Don't]]'', Blue called out Scizor to fight {{adv|Deoxys|Organism No. 1}}. Scizor was quickly outmatched by the DNA Pokémon's speed and invisibility before Organism No. 1 fled the battle.

Scizor appeared in ''[[PS274|Double Dealing with Deoxys]]'', participating in a double battle against Red. Scizor, with {{TP|Blue|Machamp}} in his pincers, flies above [[Snor]]. Scizor then drops Machamp, who proceeds to grab Snor's body. Machamp proceeds to use {{m|Seismic Toss}} and tosses Snor onto the ground and swiftly defeats him. Blue follows this up by having Scizor attack [[Gyara]] with {{m|Steel Wing}}, knocking him out too. Red sends out [[Pika]] and [[Aero]] as his last two Pokémon and has Aero use {{m|Take Down}} on Scizor, which doesn't cause [[recoil]] damage due to his {{a|Rock Head}} [[Ability]]. Aero follows up by using {{m|Dragon Claw}} on Scizor, forcing Blue to switch him out.

In ''[[PS279|Don't Doubt Deoxys]]'', Blue sends out Scizor and Machamp to attack [[Orm]]'s horde of {{p|Shuckle}}, which had bound itself to Blue. Machamp blasts that Shuckle with {{m|Hyper Beam}}, while Scizor attacks with Metal Claw. {{TP|Blue|Rhydon}} then shows up from underground and defeats the head Shuckle, scattering the rest. Blue reveals that Scizor and Machamp were simply a diversion for Rhydon to attack.

In ''[[PS302|Phew for Mew]]'', Scizor and Blue found themselves petrified by [[Sird]], along with the four other [[Pokédex holder]]s and their Pokémon.
[[File:Blue Scizor battling Rute.png|thumb|200px|Scizor battling Rute]]
==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===
In ''[[PS334|The Final Battle VII]]'', Scizor appeared alongside the rest of Blue's team when he was checking to make sure they all survived the petrification caused by {{adv|Mewtwo}} and {{p|Darkrai}}.

==={{MangaArc|X & Y}}===
In ''[[PS583|Scizor Defends]]'', Scizor battled {{adv|X}} and a wild {{p|Pinsir}}. Although X managed to get Pinsir to clamp Scizor with his horns, Scizor was too strong for the attack to do any damage. 

In ''[[PS587|Malamar Traps]]'', Blue and the group opposing [[Team Flare]] traveled to [[Pokémon Village]] to find Team Flare after they went into hiding. Scizor was used to lead them there unseen by following magnetic forces emitted by minerals leading to the village.

==Personality and characteristics==
Being with {{adv|Blue}} since before the start of the {{pkmn|manga}}, Scizor has a personality very similar to him. He is serious, calm, and focused in everything he does and does not take well to {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who do not show the same level of commitment. Due to his training with [[Chuck]], he is able to read his opponent's moves. As a Scyther, he was used mainly for his agility and fast attacks and is now used for his high defense capabilities. Blue and Scizor have a strong relationship and have been in thousands of battles together.
